profile.contractDescription: This contract binds the configured asset and amount, ETH price, parties, timing, and network domains for one marketplace offer.

functions.name: claim
functions.summary: The router's PcashBatch event for the exact payment, and the claim key, authorize release; publication and issuance routes are chosen in the claim.

configurationFields.name: configurationSalt
configurationFields.label: Configuration salt
configurationFields.description: Random salt that makes this offer's claim configuration commitment unique.

configurationFields.name: router
configurationFields.label: Payment router
configurationFields.description: Ethereum contract whose PcashBatch event must carry the claim.

configurationFields.name: seller
configurationFields.label: Payment recipient
configurationFields.description: Ethereum address the router's payment context names as the seller.

configurationFields.name: offerId
configurationFields.label: Offer ID
configurationFields.description: Identifier that binds the payment and claim key to this offer.

configurationFields.name: assetId
configurationFields.label: Asset
configurationFields.description: Standard asset held in escrow; zero is native PCASH.

configurationFields.name: amount
configurationFields.label: Configured amount
configurationFields.description: Exact base-unit amount of the configured asset authorized for release.

configurationFields.name: ethPriceWei
configurationFields.label: ETH price
configurationFields.description: Exact gross ETH payment the router's payment context must name.

configurationFields.name: deadlineT
configurationFields.label: Claim deadline
configurationFields.description: The authorized transaction must expire no later than this time.

proofGroups.title: Kernel statement
proofGroups.description: Values the function binds into the statement it returns; the kernel checks them against the spending account, the chain, and the transaction's recent block.

items.description: Recent PCASH block the transaction is anchored to.
Address of the escrow Contract Account, which owns the escrow note.
Commitment to the transaction event application and its event, passed through to the kernel statement.
PCASH chain the authorized transaction is bound to.

proofGroups.title: Payment carrier
proofGroups.description: Requires the transaction's carrier context to be the configured router's PcashBatch event for this offer ID, seller, ETH price, and the claim-key commitment of the exact escrow note spent: the router's event for that payment.

items.description: Secret whose commitment to the spent escrow note the router's payment context names.

proofGroups.title: Committed configuration
proofGroups.description: Opens the function's published configuration commitment to the exact instance terms.

items.description: Salt, router, payment recipient, offer ID, asset, amount, ETH price and claim deadline.

proofGroups.title: Authorized transaction
proofGroups.description: Proves the exact escrow input becomes the payout; a native escrow also funds an optional private relay payment and open fee.

items.description: Padded input and output slots, fee, validity window and commitments.
Opens the escrow input note's secret; the escrow contract owns it, and the configuration fixes its asset and amount.
Locates the escrow input within the output-commitment tree.
Selects the sponsored role, where the claimant's own account pays a token claim's network fee.
Commits the private payout recipient's address and note secret.
Exact private native-PCASH relay payment funded from the escrow's value, or zero; always zero for a token escrow.
Owner commitment for the escrow-funded relay payment, or zero.

functions.name: reclaim
functions.summary: Seller signature and timeout authorize reclaim.

configurationFields.name: configurationSalt
configurationFields.label: Configuration salt
configurationFields.description: Random salt that makes this offer's reclaim configuration commitment unique.

configurationFields.name: seller
configurationFields.label: Reclaim authority
configurationFields.description: Ethereum address whose EIP-712 signature authorizes reclaim.

configurationFields.name: offerId
configurationFields.label: Offer ID
configurationFields.description: Marketplace offer this reclaim function belongs to.

configurationFields.name: deadlineT
configurationFields.label: Reclaim after
configurationFields.description: Offer deadline T; the authorized transaction may become valid only after it.

configurationFields.name: domainSeparatorHigh
configurationFields.label: Signing domain (high)
configurationFields.description: High 128 bits of the EIP-712 domain separator the seller signs under; it fixes the Ethereum chain and Inbox.

configurationFields.name: domainSeparatorLow
configurationFields.label: Signing domain (low)
configurationFields.description: Low 128 bits of the EIP-712 domain separator the seller signs under.

proofGroups.title: Kernel statement
proofGroups.description: Values the function binds into the statement it returns; the kernel checks them against the spending account, the chain, and the transaction's recent block.

items.description: Recent PCASH block the transaction is anchored to.
Commitment to the transaction event application and its event, passed through to the kernel statement.
PCASH chain named in the seller's signed message.

proofGroups.title: Seller authorization
proofGroups.description: Proves the configured seller signed the offer, escrow, asset, payout, open fee, native burn, private relay payment, issuance route, and validity window.

items.description: Low-s secp256k1 signature over the semantic Marketplace reclaim message.
Signing public key; its Ethereum address is the seller the configuration commits.
Network fee and voluntary burn the seller signs when the reclaim burns native PCASH; they sum to its native burn, and both are zero when it burns none.

proofGroups.title: Committed configuration
proofGroups.description: Opens the function's published configuration commitment to the exact reclaim terms.

items.description: Salt, offer, reclaim time and the signing domain separator; the seller comes from the signing key.

proofGroups.title: Authorized transaction
proofGroups.description: Proves one exact escrow input becomes the payout after timeout; a native escrow also funds an optional private relay payment and open fee.

items.description: Padded input and output slots, fee, not-before time and validity window.
With the arena hash, opens the transaction's delivery commitment; the payout slot's hash is signed in the payout opening.
With the output-data hashes, opens the delivery commitment; signed in the payout opening.
Opens the escrow input note's secret, asset and amount; the escrow contract owns it, and the seller signs its asset.
Locates the escrow input within the output-commitment tree.
Selects the sponsored role, where the seller's own account pays a token reclaim's network fee.
Names the authenticated escrow Contract Account.
Names the signed payout recipient.
Names the signed designated issuance recipient, or zero for the open route.
Opens the designated issuance commitment, or is zero for the open route.
Blinds the signed payout-opening commitment to the payout owner and its encrypted recovery data.
Opens the exact payout note selected before the seller signs.
Exact private native-PCASH relay payment funded from the escrow's value, or zero; always zero for a token escrow.
Owner commitment for the escrow-funded relay payment, or zero.

proofGroups.description: Proves one exact escrow input becomes the payout after timeout; a native escrow also funds an optional private relay payment and open fee.

items.description: Padded input and output slots, fee, not-before time and validity window.
With the arena hash, opens the transaction's delivery commitment; the payout slot's hash is signed in the payout opening.
With the output-data hashes, opens the delivery commitment; signed in the payout opening.
Opens the escrow input note's secret, asset and amount; the escrow contract owns it, and the seller signs its asset.
Locates the escrow input within the output-commitment tree.
Selects the sponsored role, where the seller's own account pays a token reclaim's network fee.
Names the authenticated escrow Contract Account.
Names the signed payout recipient.
Names the signed designated issuance recipient, or zero for the open route.
Opens the designated issuance commitment, or is zero for the open route.
Blinds the signed payout-opening commitment to the payout owner and its encrypted recovery data.
Opens the exact payout note selected before the seller signs.
Exact private native-PCASH relay payment funded from the escrow's value, or zero; always zero for a token escrow.
Owner commitment for the escrow-funded relay payment, or zero.
